summary: Google DeepMind released version 1.0.0 of GDM Science Skills, an open-source toolkit intended to speed up agentic scientific workflows via better grounding and token efficiency, integrating AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and over 30 other scientific databases and tools.

practices.reason: A skills library claiming to improve agent grounding and token efficiency is a scaffolding technique worth evaluating, though the release note gives no implementation detail.
practices.quote: Public release of GDM Science Skills to speed up agentic scientific workflows with better grounding and higher token efficiency.

practices.reason: Adopting this toolkit means wiring an agent to 30+ external scientific databases and tools, which is integration work to plan for.
practices.quote: Integrate insights from AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and 30+ other databases and tools.
